title: PORT-BRANCH-core-5-vertex-gemini: carry core-5-vertex-gemini onto main
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** branch `core-5-vertex-gemini` at 1b71eb0f31 holds work main lacks and cannot merge as is (conflicts in code: platform/core/tests/test_vertex.py, platform/core/ultrastable/agents.py, platform/core/ultrastable/config.py, platform/core/ultrastable/engine.py)
**Done check:** probe:git rev-list --count origin/main..origin/core-5-vertex-gemini is 0, or the branch's content is carried by a merged change
**Status:** open

Port the change by hand onto current main (it is 1 commit(s) ahead), keeping tests green; then the sweep deletes the branch.

size: M

**Closing probe:** python3 -m foundation branchsweep --scan --json shows no `port` for core-5-vertex-gemini
